research_question: Can the pinned text/UI environment produce byte-identical 1000-step action/tick chains across fresh processes for all two-family seed cells under a feasible pre-frozen runtime cap?

official_discoveryworld.read_scope: Table 4 and Appendix D from preserved full text
official_discoveryworld.claim: Normal and Challenge tasks are evaluated to a maximum of 1000 steps; official evaluation spans 5 parametric seeds

failed_protocol.observation: 20/20 1000-step cells timed out at 120 seconds without complete receipts

exploratory_calibration.observation: 12/12 cells completed; exact chains through 100 steps at seed 0; median step time about 0.121s

horizon.reason: already observed and cannot answer official Normal-task 1000-step horizon
partial progress checkpoint only; not official maximum horizon
matches official Normal-task maximum and directly closes the missing long-horizon gate

timeout_seconds.reason: observed 20/20 timeout and negative median-projection headroom
23.3% median-projection headroom is vulnerable to unobserved late-horizon nonlinearity and host jitter
48.0% median-projection headroom while bounding 20 serial cells to 3600 seconds
97.3% headroom raises maximum wait to 4800 seconds without observed need

coverage.reason: calibration already covers it and source audit found unseeded RNG paths; cannot generalize to seeds 1-4
ten nested same-seed pairs across both families with family-level n=2

execution.reason: changes resource contention relative to calibration and confounds latency/determinism
matches calibrated process boundary and preserves independent repeat initialization

observability.reason: previous protocol lost all partial evidence on timeout
preserves partial chains without changing the 1000-step endpoint

selected_design.primary_success: 20 completed episodes, 20000 successful actions/ticks, 10/10 same-seed final and checkpoint chain pairs exact, no hidden keys, pinned commit
selected_design.failure_handling: all timeout/crash/malformed cells remain failure; no retry, replacement, endpoint shortening, or exclusion

falsifiers: any cell does not complete 1000 steps within 180 seconds
any action or tick is unsuccessful
any same-seed pair differs at a checkpoint or final chain
any hidden score key appears in observation
any episode runs a different repository commit
scope_limits: fixed rotate-only policy tests text/UI transition determinism, not task-solving behavior
no scorecard, task completion, correction gold, TREE/TYPED comparison or model
host subprocess network denial is Python-level, not a DiscoveryWorld Docker image certification
seeds and repeats are nested; n=2 task families
timeout selection is informed by exploratory calibration and is prospective only for this new protocol
stopping_rule: one frozen execution only after explicit approval; report PASS or FAIL and stop without repair
